notes: 6.7: Word bilingual mode now bolds/colors the translation inside table cells (and content controls, headers/footers, footnotes), not only body paragraphs; every format skips inline base64 image data (data:image/...;base64,...) instead of sending image bytes to the model; Excel sheet names are translated again (on by default, toggle in Settings) and every cross-sheet reference (formulas, defined names, validation, charts, hyperlinks, pivots) is rewritten to the new name, so no #REF!. / 6.7：Word 双语对照的表格单元格（含内容控件、页眉页脚、脚注）译文也加粗/着色，不再只有正文生效；所有格式统一跳过内嵌 base64 图片数据（data:image/...;base64,...），不再把图片字节送去翻译；Excel 工作表名重新翻译（默认开启，设置可关），改名时同步改写全部跨表引用（公式/定义名称/数据验证/图表/超链接/透视表），不再出现 #REF!。
